verdicts.reason: The two layouts are the same except for the logo. In both, the white logo band stops short of the right edge, leaving a dark gap. The body copy sits jammed under the headline. The orange divider has drifted down onto the top edge of the CTA button. The bottom quarter of the canvas is empty. In A the logo is close to the original's proportion (about a quarter of the width) and has some breathing room in its band. In B the logo is blown up to about half the width and jammed against the edges of the white band, so it competes with the headline and looks cramped.
